recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future FHIR-I tracker replaces the useContext approach with a direct element or changes the agreement-scope terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-24885 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request originally asking for ImplementationGuide.kind to identify the nature of implementation guides. The accepted resolution instead required a new usage-context-type code agreement-scope, a new usage-context-agreement-scope code system and whole-system value set, and inclusion of that value set in the broad Context of Use ValueSet.
initial_application: FHIR-I first discussed the issue in January 2020 and decided to use ImplementationGuide.useContext with codes and values instead of a direct kind element. The January 2022 FHIR-I minutes record the Persuasive with Modification vote. Source history then applied the change through the explicit FHIR-24885 merge commit 81f7c6c5f5bd573bd09ba5b9ca2adab0cd97eeb4 plus related source commits that added agreement-scope to UsageContext, added the code system/value set files, and wired the value set into use-context terminology metadata.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide remains an active resource and UsageContext remains an active data type in source/fhir.ini. The current source contains the agreement-scope usage-context-type code, the six requested agreement-scope concepts, the whole-system value set, OID registrations, binding-table metadata, and the Context of Use ValueSet include. Community searches found the expected FHIR-I minutes and no conflicting later guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding ImplementationGuide.kind now would contradict the work-group modification, and duplicating explanatory prose would not materially change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Discussed in the same January 2020 WGM minutes and co-merged in later IG work, but it concerns ImplementationGuide resource/example representation rather than agreement-scope.
Co-mentioned in the explicit FHIR-24885 implementation merge, but it concerns IG images/artifacts and is not needed for this decision.
